exposure: Robson's Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) group
cohort: All births at ≥22 weeks of gestational age in 2015 in 27 EU member states plus Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and the UK
finding: Countries providing TGCS data had lower cesarean rates than countries without data, and countries with higher cesarean rates tended to have higher rates in all TGCS groups, although substantial heterogeneity was observed.
country: 27 EU member states plus Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and the UK
